name: FLORES-200
description: A parallel multilingual evaluation benchmark covering 200 languages including many low-resource ones, providing translation evaluation data through parallel sentences translated from English Wikipedia and Wikinews articles. Serves as the gold standard for multilingual machine translation quality assessment and is used to evaluate models' ability to translate between language pairs beyond English.
typical_sota_score: BLEU varies widely by language pair (30–50 for high-resource; 5–20 for low-resource)
reputation: Gold standard for multilingual translation evaluation; released by Meta AI as part of the No Language Left Behind (NLLB) project; covers 200 languages including many with no prior MT benchmarks; widely used in industry and research
notes: Part of Meta's No Language Left Behind (NLLB) initiative. Provides parallel data for 200 languages through careful professional translation. FLORES-101 was the predecessor (101 languages); FLORES-200 significantly extends coverage. Used to evaluate NLLB-200 model which covers all 200 language pairs. Essential for evaluating low-resource language translation. Released 2022.
